name: Aktivhotel Crystal
beschreibung: The Aktivhotel Crystal is located in St. Johann in Tirol in the district of Kitzbühel. The accommodation is near the center and the mountain railway. Guests have access to a wellness area with sauna and steam bath. The hotel organizes guided hikes and ski lessons. Half board is included in the stay. The property is suitable for active holidaymakers who want to explore the Kitzbüheler Alpen.
